title: On homological Real trace methods
summary: We develop homological Real trace methods, an approach to understanding the continuous mod two Bredon homology of Real topological periodic homology and Real topological negative cyclic homology, generalizing prior work of Bruner and Rognes. We use this new approach to do several computations, including the continuous mod two Bredon homology of the Real topological negative cyclic homology of Real bordism.
